prompt:
Write the appraiser's remarks (about 80 words) on a body shop repair estimate after a hit while turning left. Describe the damage seen on the vehicle and the repair plan. No names, dates or amounts. (Internal reference C-1108; do not mention it.) Work these facts into the text naturally, in your own words, without listing them:
- The vehicle damage matches the described impact.
- Two similar charges on the same day are being checked.
- The repair labor hours fit the damage.
- No earlier damage to the vehicle is known.
text: The vehicle was struck on the front passenger side while the other driver was turning left across its path. The damage pattern is consistent with the impact described, with the bumper cover cracked, the fender crushed at the leading edge, and the headlamp assembly broken away from its mount. No earlier damage was found on the vehicle or on the panels examined. The proposed repair plan replaces the bumper cover and headlamp, straightens the fender, and refinishes the affected panels. The labor hours requested fit the extent of the damage shown. Two similar charges posted on the same day are being verified with the shop before payment is released.
